items.title: Stack fragments render without the inner framed background
items.precondition: Run the portfolio locally at a desktop viewport of at least 1024px.
steps: Open the portfolio and scroll to the Product Stack section.
Inspect the area behind the black stack fragments.
items.expected: The fragments sit directly on the section blueprint grid; there is no white card, nested border, nested grid, or center guideline behind them.
items.evidence: Local headless Chrome render at 1920x1400 confirmed the fragments on the section grid with the inner card/frame removed.
items.notes: The browser-control runtime was unavailable, so this item used a temporary direct render fixture that was removed after inspection.

items.title: Connector follows the hovered, focused, or selected fragment
items.precondition: Run the portfolio locally at a desktop viewport of at least 1024px.
steps: Hover each fragment in turn and confirm the explanation card updates.
Tab through the fragments and confirm focus updates the same state.
Click or tap a fragment and confirm the selection persists.
Watch the connector endpoints move from that fragment to the explanation card.
items.expected: A curved guide and directional dash flow attach the active fragment to the explanation card without crossing the stack.
items.notes: Requires an interactive browser run; headless screenshot mode paused the Framer interaction choreography.

items.title: Connector remains attached during resize and sticky scrolling
items.precondition: The Product Stack section is open at desktop width.
steps: Resize the viewport while a fragment is selected.
Scroll until the explanation card enters and leaves its sticky position.
items.expected: The connector recalculates without visible drift and remains attached at both ends.

items.title: Reduced motion and small-screen fallbacks remain usable
items.precondition: Browser developer tools can emulate reduced motion and a viewport below 1024px.
steps: Enable prefers-reduced-motion and inspect the connector.
Resize below 1024px and select several fragments.
items.expected: Reduced motion keeps a static guide without repeated dash/pulse animation; small screens hide the decorative connector while selection and explanation updates still work.
